nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes:
Polls every 5 minutes. Adjust the interval if you want faster/slower sync.

Since n8n v2 removed the dedicated Todoist Trigger, we use a schedule + Todoist polling approach instead.

The Code node downstream handles deduplication so the same task is never imported twice.

nodes.name: Fetch Todoist Tasks
nodes.notes:
Calls Todoist REST API v1 to fetch tasks from the Backlog project.

The deprecated n8n Todoist node was replaced with a direct HTTP
call because it still uses the old Sync API (v9).

After importing:
1. Create a credential: Settings → Credentials → Header Auth
     Name:  Authorization
     Value: Bearer YOUR_TODOIST_TOKEN
2. Select that credential in this node's 'Authentication' dropdown
3. Replace YOUR_TODOIST_BACKLOG_PROJECT_ID with your actual project ID
   (Find it by opening the Backlog project in Todoist web → URL has the ID)

Response fields: id, content, description, priority (1-4)

nodes.name: Dedup & Extract
nodes.notes:
Three jobs in one Code node:

1. DEDUP — uses workflow static data to track synced Todoist task IDs.
   If a task was already imported, it's skipped. Keeps the last 500 IDs.

2. KEYWORD — extracts a keyword from the task name for epic matching.
   Takes text before any colon/dash as the potential epic name.

3. PRIORITY — maps Todoist priority (1-4) to Notion select labels
   (Urgent / High / Medium / Low).

nodes.name: Search Epics
nodes.notes:
Queries the 🗺️ Epics database for a page whose title contains the keyword.

After importing, open this node, select your Notion credential, and add a filter:
  Property: Name
  Condition: Contains
  Value: {{ $json.keyword }}

nodes.name: Epic Found?
nodes.notes:
TRUE  → goes directly to Create Backlog Ticket with the found epic
FALSE → goes to Create Epic first, then to Create Backlog Ticket

nodes.name: Create Epic
nodes.notes:
Creates a new page in 🗺️ Epics when no matching epic is found.
Uses the extracted keyword as the epic title.
Select your Notion credential after importing.

nodes.name: Create Backlog Ticket
nodes.notes:
Creates the ticket in 📥 Backlog with all fields mapped.

Receives the epic page from either the search result (found) or
the newly created epic (not found). In both cases {{ $json.id }}
resolves to the epic's Notion page ID for the relation.

Select your Notion credential after importing.

nodes.name: Loop Each Task
nodes.notes:
Splits the task list so each task is processed individually through
Search Epics → IF → (Create Epic) → Create Backlog Ticket.

Previously the workflow assumed one task at a time (trigger mode).
Since we now poll on a schedule, multiple tasks may arrive at once.
